author: GamingBolt
description:
So, back to the original question: are the PS5 and PS5 Pro worth it? Well, even if this generation hasn’t been entirely smooth sailing, the PS5’s library is arguably stronger than ever. 

The hardware continues to benefit from meaningful improvements, while the arrival of Grand Theft Auto VI could persuade anyone who hasn’t bought in yet to, well… buy in. Just be aware: rising hardware and subscription costs mean the recommendation to buy a PS5 isn’t totally without reservation.
title: PS5 - 6 Years Later: Is It Still Worth It?

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’ve been itching to say it, and it feels so good to say that GTA 6 is now officially ten days away as we write this. We’ve been thinking a lot about what life in Leonida is going to be like, and we keep coming back to the game that’s still the benchmark and the way it handles similar aspects of the experience.

We’ve been down this road before, but there are a few more interesting stops to make along the way to justify another pass. Let’s get started!

This video draws on published previews, interviews and official footage to explore how the game’s systems could come together. We’ve also included a few hypothetical scenarios and wishlist ideas, so keep in mind that those are speculation rather than confirmed features.
title: GTA 6 vs GTA 5 - 15 MORE Confirmed Differences You Need To Know
